jobs.prompt: Hand-painted flat cel animation, 1983 Shanghai Animation Film Studio style. A five-tier stone pagoda stands on a rocky hillside above a jade-green lake, layered grey-green mountain ranges behind it, the sky split into two horizontal bands of pale cream and pale teal. Thin near-black ink contour, flat colour blocks, no gradient shading, visible paper grain. Slow mist drifts across the lake, gentle ripples move on the water surface. The camera holds perfectly still. Keep the drawing on the model sheet unchanged.
